title: PICasso：AI驱动的硅光子器件自动化设计框架
summary: PICasso是一个AI辅助框架，通过自然语言到YAML再到GDS的生成流程，结合PDK知识注入、自动布局布线、DRC/LVS验证和SAX仿真，实现光子集成电路的自动化设计。引入PIC-Set基准测试，包含36个设计任务，评估LLM性能。相比原始LLM生成，PICasso显著提升规格满足度，结构Spec@3达92.7%，功能Spec@3达52%，并降低插入损耗1.74dB。
summary_en: PICasso is an AI-assisted framework for automated photonic integrated circuit design, using NL-to-YAML-to-GDS pipeline with PDK knowledge, layout, verification, and SAX simulation. Introduces PIC-Set benchmark of 36 tasks. Improves spec satisfaction (structural Spec@3 92.7%, functional 52%) and reduces insertion loss by 1.74dB.
